name: Fobi AI Inc.
summary: Fobi AI Inc. is a global data intelligence company offering touchless solutions, contact tracing, automated marketing and artificial intelligence, mainly for brick-and-mortar businesses. Its flagship plug-and-play hardware or software system gives immediate insights and supports personalised, automated customer interaction for telecommunications, casino gaming, sports, hospitality and retail clients. It was incorporated in 2018 as Loop Insights Inc.
